item.title: YES’ Epic ‘Tales From Topographic Oceans’ Gets (Super) Super Deluxe Edition
item.description: The 2026 boxed set features a newly remastered version of the original album on both CD and vinyl; rarities; previously unreleased studio and live recordings; and several new mixes by Steven Wilson, including a Dolby Atmos version. The post YES’ Epic ‘Tales From Topographic Oceans’ Gets (Super) Super Deluxe Edition appeared first on Best Classic Bands.
